executiveSummary: 1 regression was observed in the 'Login and Logout @shard2' test after the pivot date.
The flaky rate for 'Login and Logout @shard2' increased from 0% to 20%, indicating potential timing issues.
The 'NML510 - Trial Balance Report' improved from 40% to 20% failure rate, suggesting some stability was regained.
This pattern may indicate instability in the login/logout functionality affecting user access.
Increased flakiness could lead to inconsistent user experiences during critical operations.
